text.p: ProSource Inc, which reported lower second quarter earnings, said it expects an improvement in its operations in the second half.
ProSource's second quarter earnings were hurt by the loss of a distribution contract with Arby's on April 1, 1997. The Arby's contract represented 10 percent of its sales.

The food distribution service said in a statement that it plans to expand business with existing customers and is selectively adding new restaurant chains. ProSource is beginning a distribution service test with Ruby Tuesday in select markets in the early fall.

Under a new truck agreement, the company said it should save money with a fleet sourcing and maintenance agreement with Penske Truck Leasing -- a deal that will replace 45 percent of its fleet with 1998 models.
